name: DriftX Legends: Car Racing VR
summary:
**Become a Drift Legend in VR!**

DriftX Legends: Car Racing VR puts you behind the wheel for an immersive **car drifting and racing experience**. Feel every corner as you control powerful drift cars and master the art of sideways driving across multiple challenging racing tracks.

Push your driving skills to the limit with responsive drift physics designed for exciting VR gameplay. Hit the throttle, control your slides, connect corners and chase higher drift scores as you become the ultimate **Drift Master
